name: Pine Labs Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1998, Pine Labs is a leading Indian merchant commerce platform that provides point-of-sale (POS) solutions, payment processing, and merchant financing services. [1]

flags.text: Share capital up 114900% in three years: new shares from an issue, a merger or a bonus. Only the first two dilute
Free cash flow negative in 4 of the last 5 years

business.what: Pine Labs provides payment technology services, including offline POS terminals, online payment gateways, and issuing solutions for prepaid and gift cards, enabling merchants to process transactions and access value-added services like installment payments and data analytics.

segments.name: Offline (Enterprise & Mid-market)
segments.comment: Strong enterprise retention and significant mid-market terminal deployment drove growth.

segments.name: Flow-based Income
segments.comment: Grew 25% YoY, supported by new data and marketing-related revenue streams.

segments.name: Issuing (Prepaid/Gift Cards)
segments.comment: Grew faster than the market through new gaming brands and mass transit programs.

segments.name: Online & Bill Payments
segments.comment: Secured top Q-commerce companies and a major consumer biller contract.

ledger.promise: Adjusted EBITDA margin of 34% to 35% through the year
ledger.quote: I think a steady state of about 34% to 35% is what one should expect through the year, given that Q3 was a strong quarter.
ledger.actual: Reported EBITDA margins were 17.7% in Q3 FY26, 15.1% in Q4 FY26, 12.9% in Q1 FY27, and 15.6% in Q2 FY27; FY26 EBITDA margin was 13.2%.

ledger.promise: Contribution margin of 76% to 78% on a steady state basis
ledger.quote: But on a steady state basis for nine months, we are at about 76%, which is in line with a 76% to 78% guided growth rate.
ledger.actual: Guidance was lowered to 73-74% in Q1 FY27 call (p9) and 72-75% in Q2 FY27 call (p24).

ledger.promise: Depreciation and capex range bound and coming down as percentage of top line
ledger.quote: going forward also, you will see depreciation and capex being fairly range bound and as a percentage to top line coming down.
ledger.actual: Cash from investing outflow rose to Rs 1,339 crore in FY26 from Rs 159 crore in FY25, rising from 7.0% of revenue to 49.4%.

ledger.promise: FY2027 revenue growth of 21% to 23.5% YoY
ledger.quote: We think we will be able to grow at about 21% to 23.5% on a year-on-year basis as far as revenue is concerned.
ledger.actual: H1 FY27 revenue reached Rs 1,543 crore, up 21.88% YoY from Rs 1,266 crore in H1 FY26.

ledger.promise: Deploy 130,000 POS terminals in fuel retail by end FY2027
ledger.quote: So you have said 130,000 terminals by end FY2027
ledger.actual: Deadline is end FY2027. Segment POS terminal counts are not separately reported in quarterly financial filings.

ledger.promise: Full year FY2027 EBITDA margin of at least 21%
ledger.quote: I am expecting to come in at 21 at least.
ledger.actual: Q1 FY27 reported EBITDA margin was 12.9% and Q2 FY27 was 15.6%; full year FY27 performance is ongoing.

ledger.promise: Deploy at least 10 lakh more soundboxes next year
ledger.quote: I think we will be able to capture and that is one of the things, which led me to turn around and say that we will be deploying at least 10 lakh more soundboxes in the market.
ledger.actual: Target announced in Nov 2026 for next year; rollout is pending.

ledger.promise: Engineering headcount to not increase and potentially decrease
ledger.quote: I do not see Pine Labs increasing the number of engineers going forward. If any, it could actually go down, but surely not increase.
ledger.actual: Engineering headcount figures are not reported in periodic financial filings.

current_guidance.quote: We had guided to about a 21 -23.5% growth on a full year basis.
I am expecting to come in at 21 at least.
So I would say 52% to 55% is a range we would give. It will be in that range and the mix will kind of drive where the overall numbers are, which is between 72% to 75%.
But for the full year basis, we remain guided to that range, which we have, which is about 13% to 15%.
I think we will be able to capture and that is one of the things, which led me to turn around and say that we will be deploying at least 10 lakh more soundboxes in the market.

credibility.label: mixed
credibility.summary: Management delivers reliably on headline top-line growth, with H1 FY27 revenue growing 21.9% YoY against its 21-23.5% annual guidance. However, profitability and capex promises lack discipline: contribution margin targets were repeatedly reduced from 76-78% down to 72-75%, while FY26 investing cash outflows spiked to Rs 1,339 crore despite claims of range-bound spend.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management asserted that depreciation and capex would be range-bound and fall as a percentage of revenue going forward.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Cash from investing surged to Rs 1,339 crore in FY26 from Rs 159 crore in FY25, representing 49.4% of FY26 revenue versus 7.0% in FY25.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management guided for annual revenue growth of 21% to 23.5% for FY2027.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: H1 FY27 revenue reached Rs 1,543 crore (Q1: 737, Q2: 806), delivering 21.88% YoY growth over H1 FY26 revenue of Rs 1,266 crore.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management guided to steady-state adjusted EBITDA margins of 34% to 35% through the year and later at least 21% for FY27.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Reported EBITDA margins were 12.9% in Q1 FY27 and 15.6% in Q2 FY27 (H1 FY27 average of 14.3%), remaining well below guided levels.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management explained that high working capital in Q4 was a seasonal spike due to festivity and normalizes on a full-year basis.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Debtor days rose slightly from 136 in FY25 to 140 in FY26, but the overall Cash Conversion Cycle improved from -519 days to -210 days.

bull.point: Top-line revenue execution matches annual guidance.
bull.evidence: H1 FY27 revenue grew 21.88% YoY to Rs 1,543 crore, tracking squarely inside the 21% to 23.5% full-year FY27 guidance range.

bull.point: Company achieved full-year net profitability turnaround.
bull.evidence: PAT turned positive at Rs 113 crore in FY26 from a loss of Rs 145 crore in FY25, and reached Rs 160 crore on a TTM basis.
Borrowings declined from Rs 1,046 crore in FY25 to Rs 441 crore in FY26 and further down to Rs 353 crore in FY27.

bear.point: Massive capital expenditure surge contradicted management guidance.
bear.evidence: Cash outflows from investing increased to Rs 1,339 crore in FY26 (49.4% of top line) despite assurances that capex would remain range bound and drop as a percentage of revenue.

bear.point: Contribution margin guidance has been repeatedly revised downward.
bear.evidence: Contribution margin targets dropped from 76-78% in Q3 FY26 to 73-74% in Q1 FY27 and 72-75% in Q2 FY27.

bear.point: Reported EBITDA margins consistently trail initial operating expectations.
bear.evidence: Q2 FY27 reported EBITDA margin stood at 15.6%, missing the FY27 full-year target of at least 21% and far behind the 34-35% adjusted EBITDA target stated earlier.
